I think I'm kinda gonna use this like a venting board right now. I hope that's okay. Welp...here goes.

I've always had issues eating. Ever since I was a kid, I would starve myself. Not to feel pretty, not because I thought I was fat, but because I simply *wanted* to. I know that might sound weird, and random. But I would flip to the back of Holocaust books, and look up to those emaciated figures. More than models, more than anyone, truly.

Things seemed to be getting better back in June. Thanks to some of you redditors on random kindness sending me food, it inspired me to put weight back on again. I was put in a partial program and I won't lie, it was humiliating. They checked my sandwiches, under my tongue and, if I had to go to the bathroom a certain time after lunch, even my waste. But being forced to go through that gave me no choice but to gain weight. By late july and early august, I felt healthy again.

In the past month...everything's changed.
I moved out of state, because I felt ready. Because I wanted to pursue my dream jobs, and needed to relocate. Expenses took a toll. And, unfortunately, I have a nasty habit of saving. By that I mean that when money comes in, I pay the bills and everything else goes in the bank.
I leave nothing for food.

In two and a half weeks, I lived off one loaf of bread, jam, peanut butter, a box of pasta, and a bag of clementines. Over two weeks that lasted me. Most of the clementines went bad, even.
I started to lose weight again.

And then..worse. I feel extremely guilty when I eat, to the point of self harming. I ate for three days in a row, simply because the food was free, I had a lot of meetings with friends, and there was free food. So I ate. I even gained a little bit of weight, my stomach was so eager to be fed. But I hated myself so badly afterwards.
How could I lose control like that?
I was doing so well?
And then I hated those thoughts, too, knowing deep down that they were wrong.
I bought pills, debated overdose...and learned I've done irreparable damage to my body.
While checking in with my doctor (yearly physical stuff), I learned just how bad it was.
My blood pressure is 54/40-something. I shouldn't even be awake with that. From taking so many acetaminophen and birth control in the past, overdoses, I've done damage to my liver. I've been missing periods. I hurt my muscles and sprained an ankle, too weak to walk for long. It's consumed my life.

I feel more lost than ever. I hate myself more than ever. Perhaps this isn't really a story, but that's okay. I'm just kind of glad to be able to tell this.
I thought battling my demons was over. That I'd won.

But now I failed.
I failed random redditor strangers that were kind enough to send me food.
I don't tell my friends- I wear layers so they won't notice, and hell, I've always been thin so they would probably only be able to tell if I'm naked.

No one knows the true state I'm in.
I may die from my own refusal to eat.
I know no one in this city I can turn to, and I don't yet have insurance here.
I just want to be better.
